# Completing a todo updates the counter and filters

## Add two todos
Open http://localhost:4173/. Add a todo named "Buy bread", then add a todo named "Call mom". Verify the footer counter reads "2 items left".

## Complete one todo
Tick the checkbox next to "Buy bread". Verify the footer counter reads exactly "1 item left" and the list still shows exactly two todos: "Buy bread" and "Call mom".

## Check the Active filter
Click the "Active" filter. Verify exactly one todo is shown, "Call mom", and "Buy bread" is not shown.

## Check the Completed filter
Click the "Completed" filter. Verify exactly one todo is shown, "Buy bread", and "Call mom" is not shown.
